content_items.arabic_text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
بِسْمِ ٱللَّـهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
عَنْ فاطِمَةَ الزَّهْراءِ عَلَيْهَا اَلسلام بِنْتِ رَسُول ِاللّه صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ أَنَّها قالَتْ :
دَخَلَ عَلَيَّ أَبِي رَسُولُ اللّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ فِي بَعْضِ الاْيَّامِ فَقالَ:
السَّلامُ عَلَيْكِ يَا فاطِمَةُ
فَقُلْتُ: عَلَيْكَ السَّلامُ
قالَ: إِنِّي أَجِدُ فِي بَدَنِي ضُعْفا
فَقُلْتُ لَهُ: أُعِيذُكَ بِاللّهِ يَا أَبَتاهُ مِنَ الضُّعْفِ
فَقَالَ: ”يَا فَاطِمَةُ! ٱئْتِينِي بِٱلْكِسَاءِ ٱلْيَمَانِيِّ فَغَطِّينِي بِهِ.
فَأَتَيْتُهُ بالْكِساءِ الْـيَمانِي فَغَطَّيْتُهُ بِهِ
وَصرْتُ أَنْظُرُ إِلَيْهِ وَإِذا وَجْهُهُ يَتَلَأَلَؤُ
كَأَنَّهُ الْبَدْرُ فِي لَيْلَة تَمامِهِ وَكَمالِهِ
فَمَا كانَتْ إِلاّ ساعَةً وَإِذا بِوَلَدِيَ الْحَسَنِ عليه السلام قَدْ أَقْبَلَ
وَقالَ: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكِ يَا أُمَّاهُ
فَقُلتُ: وَعَلَيْكَ السَّلامُ يَا قُرَّةَ عَيْنِي وَثَمَرَةَ فُؤَادِي
فَقَالَ: يَا أُمَّاهُ إِنِّي أَشَمُّ عِنْدَكِ رائِحَةً طَيِّبَةً
كَأَنَّها رائِحَةُ جَدِّي رَسُولِ اللّه صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ
فَقُلْتُ: نَعَمْ إِنَّ جَدَّكَ تَحْتَ الْكِساءِ
فَأَقْبَلَ الْحَسَنُ نَحْوَ الْكِساءِ وَقالَ: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا جَدَّاهُ يَا رَسُولَ اللّهِ
أَتَأْذَنُ لِي أَنْ أَدْخُلَ مَعَكَ تَحْتَ الْكِساءِ
فَقالَ: وَعَلَيْكَ السَّلامُ يَا وَلَدِي وَيَا صاحِبَ حَوْضِي
قَدْ أَذِنْتُ لَكَ ِ
فَدَخَلَ مَعَهُ تَحْتَ الْكِساء
فَمَا كانَتْ إِلاَّ ساعَةً وَإِذا بِوَلَدِيَ الْحُسَيْنِ قَدْ أَقْبَلَ وَقالَ
السَّلامُ عَلَيْكِ يَا أُمَّاهُ.
فَقُلْتُ: وَعَلَيْكَ السَّلامُ يَا وَلَدِي وَيَا قُرَّةَ عَيْنِي وَثَمَرَةَ فُؤَادِي.
فَقَالَ لِي: يَا أُمَّاهُ إِنِّي أَشَمُّ عِنْدَكِ رائِحَةً طَيِّبَةً
كَأَنَّها رائِحَةُ جَدِّي رَسُولِ اللّهُ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ.
فَقُلْتُ: نَعَمْ إِنَّ جَدَّكَ وَأَخاكَ تَحْتَ الْكِساءِ.
فَدَنَا الْحُسَيْنُ نَحْوَ الْكِساءِ
وَقالَ: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا جَدَّاهُ السَّلامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَنِ اخْتارَهُ اللّهُ
أَتَأْذَنُ لِي أَنْ أَكُونَ مَعَكُما تَحْتَ الْكِساءِ
فَقالَ: وَعَلَيْكَ السَّلامُ يَا وَلَدِي
وَيَا شافِعَ أُمَّتِي قَدْ أَذِنْتُ لَكَ.
فَدَخَلَ مَعَهُما تَحْتَ الْكِساء
فَأَ قْبَلَ عِنْدَ ذلِكَ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ عَلِيُّ بْنُ أَبِي طالِبٍ
وَقالَ: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ رَسُولِ اللّهِ.
فَقُلْتُ: وَعَلَيْكَ السَّلامُ يَا أَبَا الْحَسَنِ وَيَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ.
فَقالَ: يَا فاطِمَةُ إِنِّي أَشَمُّ عِنْدَكِ رائِحَةً طَيِّبَةً
كَانَّهَا رائِحَةُ أَخِي وَابْنِ عَمِّي رَسُولِ اللّه صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ.
فَقُلْتُ: نَعَمْ هَا هُوَ مَعَ وَلَدَيْكَ تَحْتَ الْكِساءِ
فَأَقْبَلَ عَلِيٌّ نَحْوَ الْكِساءِ
وَقالَ: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللّهِ
وأَتَأْذَنُ لِي أَنْ أَكُونَ مَعَكُمْ تَحْتَ الْكِساءِ
قالَ لَهُ: وَعَلَيْكَ السَّلامُ يَا أَخِي ويَا وَصِيِّي
وَخَلِيفَتِي وَصاحِبَ لِوَائِي قَدْ أَذِنْتُ لَكَ
فَدَخَلَ عَلِيٌّ تَحْتَ الْكِساءِ
ثُمَّ أَتَيْتُ نَحْوَ الْكِساءِ
وَقُلْتُ: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا أَبَتاهُ يَا رَسُولَ اللّهِ
أَتَأْذَنُ لِي أَنْ أَكُونَ مَعَكُمْ تَحْتَ الْكِساءِ
قالَ: وَعَلَيْكِ السَّلامُ يَا بِنْتِي وَيَا بِضْعَتِي قَدْ أَذِنْتُ لَكِ
فَدَخَلْتُ تَحْتَ الْكِساءِ
فَلَمَّا اكْتَمَلْنا جَمِيعاً تَحْتَ الْكِساءِ أَخَذَ أَبِي رَسُولُ اللّه بِطَرَفَي الْكِساءِ
وَأَوْمَأَ بِيَدِهِ ٱلْيُمْـنٰى إِلَى السَّماءِ وَقالَ:
اللّهُمَّ إِنَّ هَؤُلاءِ أَهْلُ بَيْتِي وَخاصَّتِي وَحامَّتِي
لَحْمُهُمْ لَحْمِي وَدَمُهُمْ دَمِي
يُؤْلِمُنِي مَا يُؤْلِمُهُمْ
وَيَحْزُنُنِي مَا يَحْزُنُهُمْ
أَنَا حَرْبٌ لِمَنْ حارَبَهُمْ
وَسِلْمٌ لِمَنْ سالَمَهُمْ
وَعَدُوٌّ لِمَنْ عَاداهُمْ
وَمُحِبٌّ لِمَنْ أَحَبَّهُمْ
إِنَّهُمْ مِنِّي وَأَنَا مِنْهُمْ
فَاجْعَلْ صَلَواتِكَ وَبَرَكاتِكَ وَرَحْمَتَكَ
وَغُفْرانَكَ وَرِضْوانَكَ عَلَيَّ
وَعَلَيْهِمْ وَأَذْهِبْ عَنْهُمُ الرِّجْسَ وَطَهِّرْهُمْ تَطْهِيراً.
فَقالَ اللّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ:
يَا مَلائِكَتِي وَيَا سُكَّانَ سَمَاواتِي
إِنِّي إمَا خَلَقْتُ سَماءً مَبْنِيَّةً وَلاَ أَرْضاً مَدْحِيَّةً وَلاَ قَمَراً مُنِيراً
وَلاَ شَمْساً مُضِيئَةً وَلاَ فَلَكاً يَدُورُ وَلاَ بَحْراً يَجْرِي وَلاَ فُلْكاً يَسْرِي
إِلاَّ فِي مَحَبَّةِ هَؤلاءِ الْخَمْسَةِ الَّذِينَ هُمْ تَحْتَ الْكِساءِ.
فَقالَ الاْمِينُ جَبْرائِيلُ: يَارَبِّ وَمَنْ تَحْتَ الْكِساءِ
فَقالَ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ:
هُمْ أَهْلُ بَيْتِ النُّبُوَّةِ وَمَعْدِنُ الرِّسالَةِ
هُمْ فاطِمَةُ وَأَبُوها وَبَعْلُها وَبَنُوها.
فَقالَ جَبْرائِيلُ: يَارَبِّ أَتَأْذَنُ لِي أَنْ أَهْبِطَ إِلَى الاْرْضِ
لأِكُونَ مَعَهُمْ سادِساً
فَقالَ اللّهُ: نَعَمْ قَدْ أَذِنْتُ لَكَ.
فَهَبَطَ الاْمِينُ جَبْرائِيلُ وَقالَ: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللّهِ
الْعَلِيُّ الاْعْلى يُقْرِئُكَ السَّلام َوَيَخُصُّكَ بِالتَّحِيَّةِ وَالاْكْرامِ
وَيَقُوْلُ لَكَ :وَعِزَّتِي وَجَلالِي
إِنِّي مَا خَلَقْتُ سَماءً مَبْنِيَّةً
وَلاَ أَرْضاً مَدْحِيَّةً وَلاَ قَمَراً مُنِيراً وَلاَ شَمْساً مُضِيئَةً
وَلاَ فَلَكاً يَدُورُ وَلاَ بَحْراً يَجْرِي وَلاَ فُلْكاً يَسْرِي
إِلاَّ لاِجْلِكُمْ وَمَحَبَّتِكُمْ
وَقَدْ أَذِنَ لِي أَنْ أَدْخُلَ مَعَكُمْ
فَهَلْ تَأْذَنُ لِي يَا رَسُولَ اللّه
فَقالَ رَسُولُ اللّه: وَعَلَيْكَ السَّلامُ يَا أَمِينَ وَحْي اللّهِ
فإِنَّهُ نَعَمْ قَدْ أَذِنْتُ لَكَ.
فَدَخَلَ جَبْرائِيلُ مَعَنا تَحْتَ الْكِساءِ
فَقالَ لاِبِي: إِنَّ اللّهَ قَدْ أَوْحَى إِلَيْكُمْ يَقُولُ:
إِنَّمَا يُرِيدُ اللّهُ لِيُذْهِبَ عَنْكُمُ الرِّجْسَ
أَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ وَيُطَهِّرَكُمْ تَطْهِيراً.
فَقالَ عَلِيٌّ لاِبِي: يَا رَسُولَ اللّه أَخْبِرْنِي مَا لِجُلُوسِنا
هذَا تَحْتَ الْكِساءِ مِنَ الْفَضْلِ عِنْدَ اللّهُ
فَقالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ:
وَالَّذِي بَعَثَنِي بِالْحَقِّ نَبِيَّاً
وَاصْطَفانِي بِالرِّسالَةِ نَجِيّاً
مَا ذُكِرَ خَبَرُنا هذَا فِي مَحْفِلٍ مِنْ مَحافِلِ
أَهْلِ الاْرْضِ وَفِيهِ جَمْعٌ مِنْ شِيعَتِنا وَمُحِّبِينا
إِلاَّ وَنَزَلَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ الرَّحْمَةُ
وَحَفَّتْ بِهِمُ الْمَلائِكَةُ وَاسْتَغْفَرَتْ لَهُمْ إِلى أَنْ يَتَفَرَّقُوا.
فَقالَ عَلِيٌّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ: إِذنْ وَاللّهِ فُزْنَا وَفازَ شِيعَتُنا وَرَبِّ الْكَعْبَةِ.
فَقالَ أَبِي رَسُولُ اللّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ:
يَا عَلِيُّ وَالَّذِي بَعَثَنِي بِالْحَقِّ نَبِيّاً
وَاصْطَفَانِي بِالرِّسالَةِ نَجِيّاً
مَا ذُكِرَ خَبَرُنا هذَا فِي مَحْفِلٍ مِنْ مَحَافِلِ أَهْلِ الاْرْضِ
وَفِيهِ جَمْعٌ مِنْ شِيعَتِنا وَمُحِبِّينا
وَفِيهِمْ مَهْمُومٌ إِلاَّ وَفَرَّجَ اللّهُ هَمَّهُ
وَلاَ مَغْمُومٌ إِلاَّ وَكَشَفَ اللّهُ غَمَّهُ
وَلاَ طالِبُ حاجَةٍ إِلاَّ وَقَضَى اللّهُ حاجَتَهُ.
فَقالَ عَلِيٌّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ: إِذن وَاللّه فُزْنا وَسُعِدْنا وَكَذلِكَ شِيعَتُنا
فازُوا وَسُعِدُوا فِي الدُّنْيا وَالاْخِرَةِ وَرَبِّ الْكَعْبَةِ.
اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ

content_item_translations.translation_text: O' Allāh send Your blessings on Muhammad and the family of Muhammad.
content_item_translations.transliteration: allahumma salli ala muhammadin wa ali muhammad

content_item_translations.translation_text: In the Name of Allāh,the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.
content_item_translations.transliteration: bismi allahi alrrahmini alrrahimi

content_item_translations.translation_text: Fatimatuz-Zahra, the daughter of the Prophet (s), peace be on them, is to have thus related ( an event ) :
content_item_translations.transliteration: an faat'imataz-zah-raaa-i (alayhas-salaam) binti rasoolil-laahi (S) qaalat :

content_item_translations.translation_text: My father, the Prophet (s) of Allah, came to my house one day and said to me:
content_item_translations.transliteration: dakhala a'lay-ya abee rasoolul-laahi (S) fee baa'-z'il ay-yaami faqaala :

content_item_translations.translation_text: "Peace be on you, Fatimah"
content_item_translations.transliteration: as-salaamu a'lay-ki yaa faat'imah

content_item_translations.translation_text: I replied : "And upon you be peace"
content_item_translations.transliteration: faqul-tu : a'lay-kas-salaam

content_item_translations.translation_text: Then he said : "I feel weakness in my body"
content_item_translations.transliteration: qaala : in-neee ajidu fee badanee z'ua'-faan'

content_item_translations.translation_text: I said : "May Allah protect you from weakness, father"
content_item_translations.transliteration: faqul-tu lahooo : ue'ed'uka bil-laahi yaa abataahoo manaz'-z'ua'fi

content_item_translations.translation_text: He said : "Fatimah, please bring the Yemeni cloak and cover me with it"
content_item_translations.transliteration: faqaala : yaa faat'imatu ee-teenee bil-kasaaa-il-yamaanee faghat-teenee bihi

content_item_translations.translation_text: So, I brought the Yemeni cloak and covered him with it.
content_item_translations.transliteration: fa atay-tuhoo bil-kisaaa-il-yamaanee faghat-tay-tuhoo bihi

content_item_translations.translation_text: Then, I looked at him and saw that his face was shining
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa s'ur-tu anz'uru ilay-hee wa id'aa waj-hahoo yatal-lau

content_item_translations.translation_text: like a full moon with its glory and splendor
content_item_translations.transliteration: kaan-nahul-bad-ru fee lay-lati tamaamihee wa kamaalih

content_item_translations.translation_text: After a while, my son Hasan came in
content_item_translations.transliteration: famaa kaanat il-laa saaa'taw-wa id'aa biwaladiyal-h'asani (alayhis-salaam) qad aq-bala

content_item_translations.translation_text: and said : "Peace be on you, mother"
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa qaala : as-salaamu a'lay-ki yaaa um-maah

content_item_translations.translation_text: I replied : "And upon you be peace, O light of my eyes, and the delight of my heart"
content_item_translations.transliteration: faqul-tu : wa a'lay-kas-salaamu yaa qur-rata a'y-nee wa thamarata fuaadee

content_item_translations.translation_text: He then said : "O Mother! I smell a fragrance so sweet
content_item_translations.transliteration: faqaala : yaa um-maahoo in-nee ashum-mu i'ndaki raaa-ih'atin tay-yibatin

content_item_translations.translation_text: and so pure as that of my grandfather, the Prophet (s) of Allah"
content_item_translations.transliteration: kaan-nahaa raaa-ih'atu jad-dee rasoolil-laah

content_item_translations.translation_text: I replied : "Yes. Your grandfather is underneath the cloak"
content_item_translations.transliteration: faqul-tu : naa'm in-na jad-daka tah'-tal-kisaaa

content_item_translations.translation_text: Hasan went near the cloak and said : "Peace be on you, my grandfather, the Prophet (s) of Allah;
content_item_translations.transliteration: fa aq-balal-h'asanu nah'-wal-kisaaa-i wa qaala : as-salaamu a'lay-ka yaa jad-daahoo yaa rasoolal-laahi

content_item_translations.translation_text: May I enter the cloak with you?"
content_item_translations.transliteration: ata-d'anu leee an ad-khula maa'ka tah'-tal-kisaaa

content_item_translations.translation_text: He replied : "And upon you be peace, my son and the master of my fountain (Kauthar),
content_item_translations.transliteration: qaala : wa a'lay-kas-salaamu yaa waladee wa yaa s'aah'iba h'awz'ee

content_item_translations.translation_text: you are given the permission to enter"
content_item_translations.transliteration: qad ad'intu laka

content_item_translations.translation_text: So, Hasan entered the cloak with him
content_item_translations.transliteration: fa dakhala maa'hoo tah'-tal-kisaaa

content_item_translations.translation_text: After a while, my Husain came in and said :
content_item_translations.transliteration: famaa kaanat il-laa saaa'taw-wa id'aa biwaladial-h'usay-ni qad aq-bala wa qaala :

content_item_translations.translation_text: "Peace be on you, mother"
content_item_translations.transliteration: as-salaamu a'lay-ki yaa um-maah

content_item_translations.translation_text: I replied : "And upon you be peace, O light of my eyes, and the delight of my heart"
content_item_translations.transliteration: faqul-tu : wa a'lay-kas-salaamu yaa waladee wa yaa qur-rata a'y-nee wa thamarata fuaadee

content_item_translations.translation_text: He then said : "O Mother! I smell a fragrance so sweet
content_item_translations.transliteration: faqaala lee : yaaa um-maahoo in-nee shummu i'ndaki raaa-ih'atin tay-yibatan

content_item_translations.translation_text: and so pure as that of my grandfather, the Prophet (s) of Allah"
content_item_translations.transliteration: kaan-nahaa raaa-ih'atu jad-dee rasoolil-laah

content_item_translations.translation_text: I replied : "Yes. Your grandfather and your brother are underneath the cloak"
content_item_translations.transliteration: faqul-tu : naa'm in-na jad-daka wa akhaaka tah'-tal-kisaaa

content_item_translations.translation_text: Husain stepped towards the cloak
content_item_translations.transliteration: fadanal-h'usay-nu nah'-wal-kisaaa-i

content_item_translations.translation_text: and said : "Peace be on you, my grandfather, the Chosen of Allah;
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa qaala : as-salaamu a'lay-ka yaa jad-dahoos-salaamu a'lay-ka yaa manikh-taarahul-lahoo

content_item_translations.translation_text: May I enter the cloak with you?"
content_item_translations.transliteration: ata-d'anu leee an ad-khula maa'kumaa tah'-tal-kisaaa

content_item_translations.translation_text: He replied : "And upon you be peace, my son
content_item_translations.transliteration: faqaala : wa a'lay-kas-salaamu yaa waladee

content_item_translations.translation_text: and interceder of my followers, you are given the permission to enter"
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa yaa shaafia'a um-matee qad ad'-intu lak

content_item_translations.translation_text: So, Husain entered the cloak with them.
content_item_translations.transliteration: fadakhala maa'humaa tah'-tal-kisaaa

content_item_translations.translation_text: After a while, Abul Hasan, Ali bin Abi Talib came in
content_item_translations.transliteration: faaq-bala i'nda d'aalika abul-h'asani a'lee-yub-nu abee t'aalibiw-

content_item_translations.translation_text: and said : "Peace be on you, O daughter of the Prophet (s) of Allah"
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa qaala : as-salaamu a'lay-ki yaa binta rasoolil-laah

content_item_translations.translation_text: I replied : "And upon you be peace, O father of Hasan, and the Commander of the faithful"
content_item_translations.transliteration: faqul-tu wa a'lay-kas-salaamu yaa abal-h'asani wa yaaa ameeral-mumineen

content_item_translations.translation_text: He then said : "O Fatima! I smell a fragrance so sweet and so pure
content_item_translations.transliteration: faqaala yaa faat'imatu in-nee ashum-mu i'ndaki raaa-ih'atan tay-yibatan

content_item_translations.translation_text: as that of my brother and my cousin, the Prophet (s) of Allah"
content_item_translations.transliteration: kaan-nahaa raaa-ih'atu akhee wab-ni a'm-mee rasoolil-laah sallallahu alaihi wa alihi wasallam

content_item_translations.translation_text: I replied: "Yes. He is underneath the cloak with your two sons"
content_item_translations.transliteration: faqul-tu naa'm haa hooa maa' waladay-ka tah'-tal-kisaaa

content_item_translations.translation_text: So, Ali went near the cloak
content_item_translations.transliteration: faaq-bala a'lee-yun nah'-wal-kisaaa-i

content_item_translations.translation_text: and said : "Peace be on you, Prophet (s) of Allah;
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa qaala : assalaamu a'lay-ka yaa rasoolal-laahi

content_item_translations.translation_text: May I enter the cloak with you?"
content_item_translations.transliteration: ata-d'anu leee an akoo-na maa'kum tah'-tal-kisaaa

content_item_translations.translation_text: He replied : "And upon you be peace, my brother, my successor,
content_item_translations.transliteration: qaala lahu : wa a'lay-kas-salaamu yaaa akhee wa yaa was'ee

content_item_translations.translation_text: my successor, and my standard bearer, you are given the permission to enter"
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa khalee-fatee wa s'aah'iba liwaaa-ee qad ad'intu lak

content_item_translations.translation_text: So, Ali entered the cloak with them.
content_item_translations.transliteration: fadakhala a'lee-yun tah'-tal-kisaaa

content_item_translations.translation_text: Then I stepped forward
content_item_translations.transliteration: thum-ma atay-tu nah'-wal-kisaaa-i

content_item_translations.translation_text: and said : "Peace be on you, my father, O Prophet (s) of Allah;
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa qul-tu : as-salaamu a'lay-ka yaaa abataah yaa rasoolal-laahi

content_item_translations.translation_text: May I enter the cloak with you?"
content_item_translations.transliteration: ata-d'anu leee an akoo-na maa'kum tah'-tal-kisaaa

content_item_translations.translation_text: He replied : "And upon you be peace, my daughter, O part of myself; you are given the permission to enter"
content_item_translations.transliteration: qaala : wa a'lay-kis-salaamu yaa bintee yaa baz'-atee qad ad'intu laki

content_item_translations.translation_text: So, I entered the cloak with them.
content_item_translations.transliteration: fadakhal-tu tah'-tal-kisaaa

content_item_translations.translation_text: Getting together underneath the cloak, my father, the Prophet (s) of Allah, held the two ends of the cloak
content_item_translations.transliteration: fal-lamak-tamal-naa jamee-a'n tah'-tal-kisaaa-i akhad'a abee rasoolul-laahi bitarafayil-kisaaa-i

content_item_translations.translation_text: and raised his right hand towards the heavens and prayed :
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa aw-maa biyadihil-yum-naa ilas-samaaa-i wa qaala :

content_item_translations.translation_text: "O Allah, these are the people of my Household (Ahlul-Bayt). They are my confidants and my supporters.
content_item_translations.transliteration: al-laahum-ma in-na haa-ulaaa-i ah-lu bay-tee wa khaaas'-s'atee wa h'aaam-matee

content_item_translations.translation_text: Their flesh is my flesh and their blood is my blood.
content_item_translations.transliteration: lah'-muhum lah'-mee wa damuhum damee

content_item_translations.translation_text: Whoever hurts them, hurts me too.
content_item_translations.transliteration: yu-limunee maa yu-limuhum

content_item_translations.translation_text: Whoever displeases them, displeases me too.
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa yah'-zununee maa yah'-zunuhum

content_item_translations.translation_text: I am at war with those who are at war with them.
content_item_translations.transliteration: ana h'ar-bul-liman h'aarabahum

content_item_translations.translation_text: I am at peace with those who are at peace with them.
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa sil-mul-liman saalamahum

content_item_translations.translation_text: I am the enemy of their enemies
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa a'doo-wul-liman a'adaahum

content_item_translations.translation_text: and I am the friend of their friends.
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa muh'ib-bul-liman ah'ab-bahum

content_item_translations.translation_text: They are from me and I am from them.
content_item_translations.transliteration: in-nahum-min-nee wa ana min-hum

content_item_translations.translation_text: O Allah! Bestow Your Blessings, Benevolence,
content_item_translations.transliteration: faj-a'l s'alawaatika wa barakaatika wa rah'-matika

content_item_translations.translation_text: Forgiveness and Your pleasure upon me and upon them.
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa ghuf-raanika wa riz'-waanika a'lay-ya

content_item_translations.translation_text: And keep them away from impurity (and flaws) and keep them thoroughly purified"
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa a'lay-him wa ad'-hib a'n-humur-rij-sa wa tah-hiruhum tat-heera

content_item_translations.translation_text: Then the Lord, Almighty Allah said :
content_item_translations.transliteration: faqaalal-laahoo az'-za wa jal-la :

content_item_translations.translation_text: "O My angels! O Residents of My Heavens,
content_item_translations.transliteration: yaa malaaa-ikatee wa yaa suk-kaana samaawaateee

content_item_translations.translation_text: verily, I have not created the erected Sky, the stretched earth, the illuminated moon,
content_item_translations.transliteration: in-nee maa khalaq-tu samaa-am-mab-nee-yataw-wa laa ar-z'am-mad-h'ee-yataw-wa laa qamaram-muneeraw-

content_item_translations.translation_text: the bright sun, the rotating planets, the flowing seas and the sailing ships,
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa laa sham-sam-muz'eee-ataw-wa laa falakay-yadoo-ru wa laa bah'-ray-yaj-reee wa laa fulkal yasree

content_item_translations.translation_text: but for the love of these Five underneath the cloak"
content_item_translations.transliteration: il-laa fee mah'ab-bati haa-ulaaa-il-kham-satil-lad'ee-na hum tah'-tal-kisaaa

content_item_translations.translation_text: Gabriel, the trusted angel, asked : "Who are under the cloak?"
content_item_translations.transliteration: faqaalal-ameenu jib-raaa-ee-lu : yaa rab-bi wa man tah'-tal-kisaaa

content_item_translations.translation_text: The Almighty answered :
content_item_translations.transliteration: faqaala a'z-za wa jal-la :

content_item_translations.translation_text: "They are the Household of the Prophet (s) and the assets of Prophet hood.
content_item_translations.transliteration: hum ah-la bay-tin-nuboow-wati wa maa'-dinur-risaalati

content_item_translations.translation_text: They are : Fatimah, her father, her husband and her two sons"
content_item_translations.transliteration: hum : faat'imatu wa aboohaa wa baa'-luhaa wa banoo-haa

content_item_translations.translation_text: Gabriel said : "O Lord, May I fly to earth
content_item_translations.transliteration: faqaala jib-raaa-ee-lu : yaa rab-bi ata-d'anu leee an ah-bita ilal-ar-z'i

content_item_translations.translation_text: to be the sixth of them?"
content_item_translations.transliteration: li-akoo-na maa'hum saadisaa

content_item_translations.translation_text: Allah replied: "Yes. You are given the permission"
content_item_translations.transliteration: faqaala-laahu : naa'm qad ad'intu lak

content_item_translations.translation_text: Gabriel, the trusted, landed near them and said : "Peace be on you, O Prophet (s) of Allah.
content_item_translations.transliteration: fahabatalameenu jib-raaa-ee-lu wa qaala : as-salaamu a'lay-ka yaa rasoolal-laahil-

content_item_translations.translation_text: The All-Highest conveys His peace on you and His greetings
content_item_translations.transliteration: a'lee-yul-aa'-laa yuq-riukas-salaamu wa yakhus'-s'uka bil-tah'eey-yati wa lik-raam

content_item_translations.translation_text: and says: "By My Honor and Glory, O My angels! O Residents of My Heavens,
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa yaqoo-lu laka : wa iz'-zatee wa jalaalee

content_item_translations.translation_text: verily, I have not created the erected Sky,
content_item_translations.transliteration: in-nee maa khalaq-tu samaaam-mab-nee- yataw-

content_item_translations.translation_text: the stretched earth, the illuminated moon, the bright sun,
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa laa ar-z'am-mad-h'ee-yataw-wa laa qamaram-muneeran wa laa sham-sam-muz'eeeataw-

content_item_translations.translation_text: the rotating planets, the flowing seas and the sailing ships,
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa laa falkal yadur wa laa bah'-ray-yaj-ree wa laa ful-kay-yas-reee

content_item_translations.translation_text: but for your sake and love"
content_item_translations.transliteration: il-laa li-ajlikum wa mah'ab-batikum

content_item_translations.translation_text: and Allah has given me permission to enter the cloak with you.
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa qad ad'ina leee an ad-khula maa'kum

content_item_translations.translation_text: May I join you, O Prophet (s) of Allah?"
content_item_translations.transliteration: fahal ta-d'anu lee yaa rasoolal-laahi

content_item_translations.translation_text: The Prophet (s) replied : "And peace be on you, O trusted bearer of Allah's Revelations!
content_item_translations.transliteration: faqaala rasoolul-laahi : wa a'lay-kas-salaamu yaa amee-na wah'-yil-laahi

content_item_translations.translation_text: you are granted the permission"
content_item_translations.transliteration: naa'm qad ad'intu lak

content_item_translations.translation_text: So, Gabriel entered the cloak with us
content_item_translations.transliteration: fadakhala jib-raaa-ee-lu maa'naa tah'-tal-kisaaa-i

content_item_translations.translation_text: and said to my father : Allah sends His Revelations to you;
content_item_translations.transliteration: faqaala li-abee : in-nal-laaha qad aw-h'aaa ilay-kum yaqoolu :

content_item_translations.translation_text: "Verily Allah's desire is to keep you away from impurity (and flaws),
content_item_translations.transliteration: in-namaa yuree-dul-laahoo li-yud'-hiba a'nkumur-rij-sa

content_item_translations.translation_text: O People of Household (Ahlul-Bayt) and keep you thoroughly purified"
content_item_translations.transliteration: ah-lal-bay-ti wa yutah-hirakum tat-heera

content_item_translations.translation_text: Then Ali said to my father : "O Prophet (s) of Allah, tell me
content_item_translations.transliteration: faqaala a'lee-yul li-abee : yaa rasoolal-laahi akh-bir-nee maa lijuloosinaa

content_item_translations.translation_text: what significance has Allah given for getting together underneath this cloak ?"
content_item_translations.transliteration: haad'aa tah'-tal-kisaaa-i minal-faz'-li i'ndal-laah

content_item_translations.translation_text: The Prophet (s) replied :
content_item_translations.transliteration: faqaalan-nabee-yu s'al-lal-laaho a'lay-hi wa aaalihi:

content_item_translations.translation_text: "By Him who rightfully appointed me a Prophet (s)
content_item_translations.transliteration: wal-lad'ee baa'thanee bi-h'aq-qi nabee-

content_item_translations.translation_text: and chose me a Messenger for the salvation of the mankind.
content_item_translations.transliteration: yaw-was'-tafaanee bir-risaalati naj-jeea

content_item_translations.translation_text: whenever and wherever an assembly
content_item_translations.transliteration: maa d'ukira khabarunaa haad'aa fee mah'-falim-mim-mah'aafili

content_item_translations.translation_text: of our followers and friends mention this event,
content_item_translations.transliteration: ah-lil-ar-z'i wa fee-hi jam-u'm-min shee-a'tinaa wa muh'-ib-bee-naa

content_item_translations.translation_text: Allah will bestow on them His Blessings and Mercy;
content_item_translations.transliteration: il-laa wa nazalat a'lay-himur-rah'-mah

content_item_translations.translation_text: angels will encircle them asking Allah the remission of their sins until the assembly disperses
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa h'af-fat bihimu lamalaaa-ikah was-tagh-farat lahum ilaaa ay-yatafar-raqoo

content_item_translations.translation_text: So Ali said : "Verily, by the Lord of Kabaa! we and our followers are the winners"
content_item_translations.transliteration: faqaala a'lee-yun a'lay-his-salaamu : id'aw-wal-laahi fuz-naa wa faaza shee-a'tunaa wa rab-bil-kaa'-bah

content_item_translations.translation_text: Then my father replied :
content_item_translations.transliteration: faqaala abee rasoolul-laahi s'al-lal-laaho a'lay-hi wa aaalihi:

content_item_translations.translation_text: "By Him who rightfully appointed me a Prophet
content_item_translations.transliteration: yaa a'lee-yu wal-lad'ee baa'thanee bil-h'aq-qi nabee-yaw

content_item_translations.translation_text: and chose me a Messenger for the salvation of the mankind,
content_item_translations.transliteration: was'-tafaanee bir-risaalati najee-ya

content_item_translations.translation_text: whenever and wherever an assembly
content_item_translations.transliteration: ma d'ukira khabarunaa haad'aa fee mah'-falim-mim-mah'aafili ah-lil ar-z'i

content_item_translations.translation_text: our followers and friends mentions this event,
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa fee-hi jam-u'm-min shee-a'tinaa wa muh'ib-bee-naa

content_item_translations.translation_text: there shall remain none grieved but Allah will remove his grief,
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa fee-him mah-moo-mun il-laa wa far-rajal-laaho ham-mahoo

content_item_translations.translation_text: there shall remain none distressed but Allah will dispel his distress,
content_item_translations.transliteration: walaa magh-moo-mun il-laa wa kashafal-laaho gham-mahoo

content_item_translations.translation_text: there shall remain none wish-seeker but Allah will grant his wish."
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa laa t'aalibu h'aajatin il-laa wa qaz'al-laaho h'aajatah

content_item_translations.translation_text: `Ali, peace be upon him, said, "Then, we have won and attained pleasure. I swear it by Allah. So have our adherents;
content_item_translations.transliteration: faqaala a'lee-yun a'lay-his-salaamu id'aaw-wal-laahi fuz-naa wa sui'd-naa wa kad'aalika shee-atunaa

content_item_translations.translation_text: they have won and attained pleasure in this world and in the Hereafter. I swear it by the Lord of the Ka`bah."
content_item_translations.transliteration: faazoo wa sui'doo fid-dunyaa wal aaakhirati wa rab-bil-kaa'-bah

content_item_translations.translation_text: O' Allāh send Your blessings on Muhammad and the family of Muhammad.
content_item_translations.transliteration: allahumma salli ala muhammadin wa ali muhammad
